name: moly-desktop
description: Moly Desktop - Local AI Chat with Ollama
author: Moly

scripts.start: BROWSER=none concurrently "npm run dev" "wait-on http://localhost:3000 && ELECTRON_DISABLE_SANDBOX=1 electron ."
scripts.start:bg: BROWSER=none npm run dev > /dev/null 2>&1 & ELECTRON_DISABLE_SANDBOX=1 electron . > /dev/null 2>&1 &
scripts.postbuild: cp src/main.js build/electron.js && cp src/preload.js build/preload.js && cp -r src/services build/ && mkdir -p build/resources && cp -r public/resources/* build/resources/ 2>/dev/null || true && cp public/integrated-layout.html build/ 2>/dev/null || true
scripts.build: react-scripts build && npm run postbuild && electron-builder
scripts.build-win: react-scripts build && npm run postbuild && electron-builder --win
scripts.build-mac: react-scripts build && npm run postbuild && electron-builder --mac
scripts.build-linux: react-scripts build && npm run postbuild && electron-builder --linux
